content.text: No customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination fees appear anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no liquidated damages or penalty payable by Client (our party). The termination provision (§14) requires no exit fee or payment of remaining contract value — service simply runs to the last day of the month following notice, so Client pays only ordinary fees for services actually received. The term/non-renewal provision (§13) likewise imposes no charge for non-renewal or early cessation, only operational obligations to move to a new name server/hosting environment. The spam covenant in §7 (p0049) prohibits conduct but attaches no per-incident charge or penalty. The only Client payment obligations are ordinary fees under §5, including recurring minimum monthly fees for Hosting and Support Services during the term; these are a service-level pricing commitment, not a liquidated sum triggered by termination or breach, so they fall outside this rule. Service-credit/vendor-side amounts are not implicated. Consistent with the playbook preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), no redline is required.
